parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  source: 'chatwoot',
  session_id: 'chatwoot-' + $('Chatwoot Webhook').item.json.body.conversation.id,
  inquiry_type: ['booking','general','tour_package','callback'].includes($json.inquiry.inquiry_type) ? $json.inquiry.inquiry_type : 'general',
  activity_name: $json.inquiry.activity_name || '',
  requested_date: (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test($json.inquiry.requested_date || '') ? $json.inquiry.requested_date : null),
  participants: parseInt($json.inquiry.participants) || 1,
  booking_type: $json.inquiry.booking_type === 'private' ? 'private' : 'sharing',
  pickup_location: $json.inquiry.pickup_location || '',
  pickup_time: $json.inquiry.pickup_time || '',
  customer_name: $json.inquiry.customer_name || '',
  contact_phone: $json.inquiry.contact_phone || '',
  contact_email: $json.inquiry.contact_email || '',
  preferred_callback_time: $json.inquiry.preferred_callback_time || '',
  conversation_notes: 'From website chat. ' + ($json.inquiry.details || '')
}) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ content: $('Decide: reply or handoff').item.json.reply + ($json.inquiry_number ? '\n\nYour request reference: ' + $json.inquiry_number : ''), message_type: 'outgoing' }) }}
